⛔ Not a claim.

- Read fresh (filed from duly, a browser measurement). A regression from 17.2 to 18.2: the import wizard's mapping step refuses an unmapped required field even when the field has a `defaultValue`, static or CEL, which the write path fills. The same file imported 19 rows on 17.2.0. `domain:ui`, p2. Read the write path's default handling before claiming, so the wizard asks the same question the engine answers.

domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y

Claim amended · 2026-11-02T04:19Z · file surface widened by the two producers of the wizard's fields, and the Clause-② line corrected. Branch and session are unchanged.

File surface (added):
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/importTargetFields.ts` and its test (the object page's producer of the wizard's fields).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/ExcelImportBar.tsx` (`normalizeFields`, the AI import bar's producer).
Both pass the field definition's `defaultValue` through, one line each. The options already pass through raw.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Reading (the dev's measurement at `origin/main` `9a9823d9`, a scratch probe on the real `POST /data/:object/import`, since deleted):
- The write path applies a static default, a CEL default and an option marked `default: true` to a row that omits the column or leaves its cell blank.
- A required field with no default is still refused.
- The wizard never sees defaults, because both producers drop them. So `ImportWizard`'s field type gains `defaultValue?: unknown` and its option type gains `default?: boolean`. These are new optional members of the exported `ImportWizardProps` in the published `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, so the declaration is `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
- No published schema or governed text moves, so the review owed is the lane seat's own `TIER_DEFAULT` review of record (`contract-review.md`), not a contract-review-tier one.
- The wizard checks only whether a default is present and never evaluates it.
